# Akutagawa regression fixtures

Fetched from official primary sources on 2026-10-04:
- https://bungakushinko.or.jp/award/akutagawa/list.html
- https://books.bunshun.jp/articles/-/5210 (round 162, 2019 second half)
- https://books.bunshun.jp/articles/-/11012 (round 175, 2026 first half)

These are structural HTML extracts, not byte-for-byte raw pages. Winner extracts preserve original round/year labels, title/author/publication spans and explicitly marked pronunciation spans. Nominee extracts preserve canonical URL and headline/section/candidate headings, omitting prose biographies, images, scripts and navigation. First-party announcements include five nominees in each covered round. The round-162 announcement also includes Naoki nominees: tests verify that those do not enter Akutagawa coverage. Raw captures remain in the task workspace.

The official winner archive contains 222 result rows: 189 winning works and 33 explicit no-award rounds, covering rounds 1–175. Joint winners remain separate. Nominees who won the same round are promoted once, leaving eight non-winning nominations and 197 distinct public results. English aliases are separately reviewed and attributed in awards/data/akutagawa_provenance.md.
